title: Playing around Atlanta in the Hamilton and Montgomery band
summary: He worked a good deal while at school, in the Hamilton and Montgomery band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Way before my time. How much playing did you do around Atlanta and Decatur and that area?
Oh, I did quite a bit of work while I was there. Yeah, I was in school and we had a band there. Merrill Mayer Hamilton and they called it the Hamilton and Montgomery band.
Hamilton and Montgomery, Neil Montgomery and Merrill Hamilton. I played there for quite a while.
